there is now this warning

epan/proto.c:8854 -- proto_register_field_init(): 'gdt.id' exists multiple times with incompatible types: FT_INT32 and FT_STRING

Is this caused by the following warnings?
```
enerating packet-gdt-stamp
ASN.1 to Wireshark dissector compiler
:0: UserWarning: The same field names for different types. Explicit field renaming is recommended.
id
 id                   IA5String            EndPointDescriptor/id
 id_01                ParameterType        Parameter/id

```

And can you tell me you how to get this warning? This is my workflow:
```
build$ cmake -DENABLE_EXTRA_COMPILER_WARNINGS=ON ..
$ make -j6 > /tmp/out.txt 2>&1
```
And when I check the output file, I can't seem to find the `epan/proto.c:8854` warning anywhere.

Ok, I think I found the problem in `gdt.cnf`:
```
#.FIELD_RENAME
Parameter/id parameter_id
```
After adding the `FIELD_RENAME` line, I am no longer getting any warnings from `asn2wrs`.
Should be fixed in 16e2bfe2cdcee8b696295306c9fe6853022959f3
